name: Rikkei Finance
fix_description: Add onlyOwner or onlyAdmin modifier to setOracleData. The function is external without any access control, allowing anyone to replace the price oracle with a malicious contract that returns arbitrary prices.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very short, direct exploit centered on an obvious access-control/oracle-manipulation flaw: the attacker repoints the oracle for collateral to their own contract, inflates the reported price, borrows all available USDC, then restores the oracle. It requires only a few calls and minimal protocol-specific reasoning beyond basic lending market collateralization.
